fit: Fixed previous4192TRAIN, assessment4000TRAIN; models fresh zero initial. Both fits sealed before assessment/VALID scoring. All40classes preserved including absent23.
hypothesis: Given frozen contextual word features and marked entity roles, simple directed entity/context pooling may repair task errors left by native typed pooling. Additional given types are a separate classical input control, not a quantum mechanism.
objective: Mean40class CE+.5*(1/4192)*norm² for all weights and bias. Equivalent regularization C1 under sum-loss convention. Fixed blockwise fit-only centered unit-RMS-energy features, type-onehot unscaled.
comparison: Report untyped/typed separately against frozen hard type rule, paired net repairs, and typed versus untyped. Historical Q-RMEA used full TRAIN, so fit budgets differ and comparison is exploratory only.
decision: Each arm is positive diagnostic only if macro>frozen rule and netpairedcorrect>0. If typed adds benefit, type input remains relevant; if untyped suffices, classical entity/context pooling already explains more error. Neither arm supports quantum advantage or L5.
stop: No tuning/retry/feature/split/budget rescue after valid negative. Bounded null does not reject whole classical model family.
recovery: Short deterministic CPU diagnostic; existing immutable feature inputs are pinned/rebuildable, no persistent recovery checkpoint/COS required.
lifecycle: Unchanged accepted host_run.py allocation wrapper; source core, GPU pool, resume, COS and export not modified. One objective fixture and actual convex fits only; no lifecycle matrix.
